description: A reddish-brown, fox-like wild canid with a bushy white-tipped tail stands alert on dark tussock grass under a stormy sky. Behind it, a stone cottage with a fence sits on a bleak moorland, with grazing sheep scattered across the plain. In the right background, a silhouetted figure in a wide-brimmed hat aims a long rifle. The image is an edge-to-edge painting with no visible text, frame or border.
